what.text: This page follows refugees from Albania in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 21447 refugees from Albania.
France hosts the largest share, 56.6%, followed by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Albania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 to 2012 and 2016 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 100 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 21919, at the end of 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
